long_state_bug: data_wf_long rendered the case facts last and training right-truncated at max_state, so 98.8% of long-policy rows lost their facts at 1,024 tokens (REPORT §3ag, commit 2fad326). Two different fixes shipped. tm2 moves the facts first and widens the window: 2,048-token states with --drop_truncated, reading .950 on 605 held-out facts-first long states against tm1b's .612. typical-small v3 (ts1b_semif) instead changes the render to the SemIf layout and keeps ts1b's original recipe -- 1,024-token states, --drop_truncated off -- and reads .952. That is the stronger result: the facts survive truncation because of where the render puts them, not because the window grew. It is also the only small checkpoint strong in both orders, .952 facts-first and .846 facts-last, where ts1c read .947 / .790 (buffalo:RESULTS.md#5b).
